item.title: Show, Don’t Tell: Make Your Grad Essay Stand Out (Writing Lab Workshop)
item.description: October 7th, 2026: 4-5pm in the Fishbach Room, Folsom Library A strong application essay relies on specific evidence rather than general claims. This workshop covers the “show, don’t tell” principle and how to use concrete examples and details to support statements about a student’s strengths, interests, and goals. Students will leave with strategies for revising general statements into more persuasive, evidence-based writing.

item.title: Entrepreneur of the Year Award Celebration and Pitch Event
item.description: October 21, 2026 - 1:00pm - Entrepreneur of the Year Award celebration. Innovation is a significant part of RPI’s storied past. The award recognizes successful entrepreneurs whose vision, commitment, and creativity exemplify the entrepreneurial spirit that is the past, present, and future of RPI. This year’s honoree is Ajit Prabhu ’98, the founder of Quest Global. The awards ceremony, fireside chat with President Schmidt, and an RPI startup pitch competition will be held in the EMPAC theater.

item.description: Date: Wednesday, October 7, 2026 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM - President’s Town Meeting is an opportunity for students, faculty, and staff to hear updates from President Martin A. Schmidt on the state of the Institute, recent accomplishments, strategic priorities, and future plans. The program includes insights into key initiatives and campus developments, followed by an open Q&A session where attendees can ask questions and engage in discussion.

item.title: Felix Deufel & Matthew Goodheart on Immersive Audio
item.description: Date: Thursday, October 8, 2026 6:00 PM - 7:00 PM - What can sound mean for humans and the environment? And how can immersive audio environments clarify—or create—these meanings? Researcher and artist Felix Deufel (ZiMMT, Leipzig), joins RPI composer and technologist Matthew Goodheart to talk about spatial sound, acoustics, composition, and their effects on human experience. All are welcome. Stay afterwards for refreshments and informal conversation in Evelyn’s Café at EMPAC.

item.title: Division of Human Resources: Supervisory Essentials
item.description: Rensselaer’s Managers and Supervisors play a pivotal role in the success of the Institute. More than any other factor, the relationships that they forge with employee direct reports and colleagues contribute to defining the levels of engagement and job satisfaction that our employees feel. These Managers and Supervisors are the fulcrum of the Employee Value Proposition, carefully balancing the needs of the individual and the organization.

item.title: Reminder for Faculty: NSF GRFP Letters of Recommendation due Oct. 16th
item.description:
Letters of recommendation for students applying to the NSF GRFP are due October 16th, days BEFORE the students applications are due. Students will not be able to submit their applications if your recommendations are not entered by the deadline. Encourage your students to seek a review from Betty Madigan prior to submitting their applications: formatting requirements have changed! Faculty may also request feedback on their recommendation letters. Send any drafts or questions to madige@rpi.edu.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
